title: The Forge Difference
questions: Why is Forge located inside a gym?

Because rehabilitation shouldn’t stop when you leave the treatment table. Being located inside a training environment allows us to transition seamlessly from hands-on treatment and movement assessment into strength, conditioning, and functional exercise.
Do I need to be a member of the gym?
No. Your physical therapy services at Forge are separate from gym membership.
Will I be able to use the gym equipment during my treatment?
Yes. Your treatment may incorporate the gym’s available strength and conditioning equipment when appropriate for your rehabilitation and goals.
Is Forge just physical therapy or is it personal training?

Forge is a physical therapy practice. Treatment is provided by a licensed physical therapist and is individualized based on your injury, movement limitations, and goals. For appropriate patients, rehabilitation can progress into strength and performance-focused training as part of the return-to-activity process.
